# origincloud_network_internet_gateway (Resource)

A VPC's way to and from the internet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the internet gateway is in. Changing it replaces the internet gateway.
- `region` (String) The region the internet gateway is in. Changing it replaces the internet gateway.
- `vpc` (String) The VPC the gateway connects, in the same project and region. Changing it replaces the internet gateway.

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the internet gateway was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the internet gateway, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`; empty for one the platform created.
- `id` (String) The internet gateway's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The gateway's resource name.
- `urn` (String) The gateway's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
